nd16a6e89a3.summary: Lebanon is experiencing a severe economic and financial crisis marked by a rising dollar exchange rate and reduced government subsidies on medicines and basic goods.

n6cb4e579a2.headline: All G20 members on board with tax deal – Germany’s Scholz
n6cb4e579a2.summary: The G20 group of large economies has reached broad agreement on a business tax reform deal to stop tax avoidance, according to Germany's Chancellor Scholz.
n6cb4e579a2.why: The G20 includes the world's largest economies, and a coordinated tax reform can significantly impact multinational corporations' tax liabilities and global investment flows.
n6cb4e579a2.why_moved: The G20's unanimous backing signals a major shift in international tax policy, likely affecting corporate tax rates and investment strategies worldwide.

n3f573da08d.headline: G20 signs off on tax crackdown, warns on virus variants
n3f573da08d.summary: Finance chiefs of the G20 large economies endorsed a landmark move to stop multinational tax avoidance and warned on virus variants.
n3f573da08d.why: The G20 includes the world's largest economies whose coordinated tax policies impact global corporate taxation and economic stability.
n3f573da08d.why_moved: The G20 agreement signals a major shift in global tax policy, increasing compliance costs for multinationals and affecting investment decisions.

n3cafb3fe64.headline: An important date in Oman and Saudi diplomacy
n3cafb3fe64.summary: His Majesty Sultan Haitham bin Tarik of Oman made an official visit to Saudi Arabia, marking a significant date in bilateral diplomacy.
n3cafb3fe64.why: Diplomatic relations between Oman and Saudi Arabia influence regional economic cooperation and geopolitical stability in the Middle East.
